name: hatch-vscode
description: Write and maintain structure-aware patches over upstream code: generate a .hatch patch from your edits, see where every hunk lands, and move between the patch and the code

virtualWorkspaces.description: Hatch spawns its core as a child process and measures patch paths from the .git directory, so it needs the files on a real file system.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Patches are generated and read. Until the workspace is trusted, a patch its hatch.config.json sends outside the workspace is written only after you confirm, the hatch.out setting of the workspace is ignored, and no hatch.config.json is created.

commands.title: Go to What the Hunk Replaces

editor/title.when: resourceScheme == file && editorLangId != hatch && resourceExtname in hatch.extensions

hatch.out.markdownDescription: Where patches go. A directory (or a path ending with a slash) receives `<file name>.hatch`; a file must be named `*.hatch`. With `upstream` set in `hatch.config.json` it is the root of the patch tree. Config key: `generate.out`. Leave unset to let `hatch.config.json` decide; setting it here overrides the project config for you only.

hatch.language.markdownDescription: Force a language instead of deriving it from the file extension. Config key: `generate.language`. Leave unset to let `hatch.config.json` decide; setting it here overrides the project config for you only.

hatch.exact.markdownDescription: Reproduce the file byte for byte instead of matching every line after normalization. Config key: `generate.exact`. Leave unset (`null`) to let `hatch.config.json` decide; setting it here overrides the project config for you only.

hatch.bridgeGap.markdownDescription: Stitch edits separated by up to this many unchanged non-blank lines into a single hunk. Config key: `generate.bridgeGap`. Leave unset (`null`) to let `hatch.config.json` decide; setting it here overrides the project config for you only.

hatch.parents.min.markdownDescription: Enclosing blocks every pattern carries. A hunk with no parent is not structural: drifting neighbours can land it in another function. Config key: `generate.parents.min`. Leave unset (`null`) to let `hatch.config.json` decide; setting it here overrides the project config for you only.

hatch.parents.max.markdownDescription: Cap on climbing up: at most this many enclosing blocks per pattern, or `"all"`. Config key: `generate.parents.max`. Leave unset (`null`) to let `hatch.config.json` decide; setting it here overrides the project config for you only.

hatch.parents.detail.base.markdownDescription: Bracket levels spelled out in parent headers, counting from the outermost: `0` gives `foo( ... )`, `1` gives `foo(bar( ... ))`. Readability against drift-tolerance, never correctness. Config key: `generate.parents.detail.base`. Leave unset (`null`) to let `hatch.config.json` decide; setting it here overrides the project config for you only.

hatch.parents.required.markdownDescription: Never fall back to a parentless pattern: fail instead of emitting an anchor that drift can move. Config key: `generate.parents.required`. Leave unset (`null`) to let `hatch.config.json` decide; setting it here overrides the project config for you only.

hatch.siblings.min.markdownDescription: Neighbouring significant lines every pattern carries, per side. Config key: `generate.siblings.min`. Leave unset (`null`) to let `hatch.config.json` decide; setting it here overrides the project config for you only.

hatch.siblings.max.markdownDescription: Cap of neighbouring significant lines per side. `0` forbids leaning on neighbours at all, keeping anchoring purely structural. Config key: `generate.siblings.max`. Leave unset (`null`) to let `hatch.config.json` decide; setting it here overrides the project config for you only.

hatch.siblings.detail.base.markdownDescription: Same bracket baseline for neighbour anchors. Config key: `generate.siblings.detail.base`. Leave unset (`null`) to let `hatch.config.json` decide; setting it here overrides the project config for you only.

hatch.base.head.markdownDescription: Compare the buffer with this file as of the last commit of the current branch, instead of with the file as saved on disk. `false` compares with the saved file even when the project config names a git base. With `hatch.base.branch` or `hatch.base.commit` set it is implied. Config key: `generate.base.head` (config schema 2). The three `hatch.base.*` settings name the base whole: any of them set replaces the config's `generate.base` entirely. Leave unset (`null`) to let `hatch.config.json` decide; setting it here overrides the project config for you only.

hatch.base.branch.markdownDescription: Compare with the file as of the last commit of this branch, local or remote-tracking (`main`, `origin/main`). Config key: `generate.base.branch` (config schema 2). Leave unset to let `hatch.config.json` decide; setting it here overrides the project config for you only.

hatch.base.commit.markdownDescription: Compare with the file as of this commit. Beside `hatch.base.branch` it must be a commit that branch holds. Config key: `generate.base.commit` (config schema 2). Leave unset to let `hatch.config.json` decide; setting it here overrides the project config for you only.

hatch.base.eol.markdownDescription: Line endings of a base read out of git: `repository` — as git stores the file; `worktree` — as the file on disk has them, for repositories with `core.autocrlf`. Applies with a git base named by `hatch.base.head`, `hatch.base.branch` or `hatch.base.commit`. Config key: `generate.base.eol` (config schema 2). Leave unset (`null`) to let `hatch.config.json` decide; setting it here overrides the project config for you only. When neither sets it, the editor reads with `worktree` — the buffer is compared as it is on disk — while the CLI keeps `repository`.
